summary.text: Jay Gallé is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 104, which the legislature's member page lists as covering St. Tammany Parish. First elected in 2023, Jay Gallé chairs the House Select Committee on Homeland Security and sits on the Insurance, Judiciary, and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jay Gallé's occupation as self-employed, with a B.A. from Loyola University of New Orleans.

The House page lists Jay Gallé's committee assignments as Insurance, Judiciary, Ways and Means, House Select Committee on Homeland Security (chair), Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and Northshore Delegation.
